title: HQBase - your team's email on Cloudflare
excerpt: Shared mailboxes, team access, and email workflows running on your Cloudflare infrastructure.
content_html:
Your team's email. On your Cloudflare infrastructure.

Free. Open source. Self-hosted. Unlimited seats.

Email that works for the whole team

Share inboxes, manage access, and connect AI tools, while your mail stays in your Cloudflare account.

Email via MCP

Connect AI clients over OAuth to search, draft, reply, and send.

Multiple domains and mailboxes

Bring all your domains and mailboxes into one place.

Access by mailbox

Give each team member access to their respective mailboxes.

Access anywhere

Polished desktop and mobile PWA client with self hosted push notifications.

Your Cloudflare account

Your Worker, D1 mail index, and R2 attachments stay yours.

Updates with a way back

Verify every release, back up first, and roll back when needed.

Frequently asked questions

What to know before running HQBase in your Cloudflare account.
